risk_signals.description: Vendor name suggests the invoice may be fraudulent.
Due date is not a real date and is before the invoice date.
Notes pressure immediate payment to avoid penalties and request a wire transfer.
risk_signals.quote: URGENT - Pay immediately to avoid penalties!!! Wire transfer preferred.

lines.note: Exact catalog match for FakeItem; stock is 0 so 100 is not available.

validation.summary: Line 1 matches catalog item FakeItem. Requested quantity 100 exceeds stock of 0.

vp.rationale: Reject. Fixed outcome and an error-level finding: FakeItem stock is 0 while the invoice requests 100, so the line cannot be fulfilled. Invoice INV-1003 from Fraudster LLC is USD, total $100,000.00 (above the $10,000 strict-review threshold). Catalog unit price was not returned, so no price-above-catalog finding is confirmed. History shows no prior runs for INV-1003. Vendor-name, due-date (“yesterday”), immediate-payment, and wire-transfer warnings are risk signals only and are not the basis for rejection; the out-of-stock error is.
checklist_responses: Error — FakeItem out of stock: lookup shows stock 0; invoice requests 100 × $1,000.00. Error-level finding requires reject.
Total $100,000.00 exceeds $10,000 strict-review threshold, but fixed outcome is already reject due to the stock error.
Catalog price: lookup returned catalog_unit_price null; do not treat price as above catalog.
Invoice history for INV-1003: no prior runs, so no corroborated invoice-number conflict.
Warning — vendor name Fraudster LLC: risk signal only; not independently corroborated beyond the name; does not change the reject already required by the stock error.
Warning — due date “yesterday” is not a real date and is before 2026-01-20: risk signal only; does not change the reject decision.
Warning — immediate payment terms and urgent wire-transfer notes: risk signals only; no separate payment-redirect instruction corroborated in history; reject stands on the out-of-stock error.

critic.summary: The reject decision matches the fixed policy outcome and the corroborated out-of-stock error, and every finding and checklist claim is supported by the case file.
